text:
You need an AI specialist who can improve your e-commerce experience, personalize wellness offerings, and support tailored VIP retreat experiences with practical, business-focused machine learning.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in AI and machine learning with a strong focus on Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. Your role is a strong fit for my background because it combines predictive modeling, personalization, and cross-functional implementation—all areas where I can contribute directly.

For your wellness programs and e-commerce optimization goals, I would approach the work by first understanding the business objectives, available data, and the customer journeys you want to improve. From there, I can help design AI solutions that support product recommendations, customer behavior analysis, and personalized experiences for your audience. That could include recommendation logic for wholesome foods and wine, predictive models for customer preferences, and NLP-driven systems that help tailor communication and engagement.

I also understand the importance of making AI useful in a live business environment, not just in theory. I can work closely with development and IT teams to integrate models into your existing workflows and help ensure the solutions are practical, maintainable, and aligned with your goals. I keep up with current AI developments and can suggest improvements as your products and audience needs evolve.

If selected, I would focus on delivering AI systems that are thoughtful, reliable, and tailored to the premium nature of your brand. Your company’s mix of wellness, luxury, and e-commerce creates an interesting opportunity to use AI in ways that feel both personalized and strategically valuable.

I’d be glad to discuss how I can help you build AI-driven features that improve customer experience, streamline operations, and support your wellness and retreat offerings.
